output.answer_markdown: HP says a failure to comply with customer contracts or government contracting regulations could lead to civil and criminal penalties, including termination of contracts, forfeiture of profits, suspension of payments, and, for government contracts, fines and suspension from future government contracting [1]. HP also says such failures could cause reputational damage and that negative publicity about customer contracts may hurt its ability to compete for new contracts [2]. HP notes that it has in the past been, and may in the future be, subject to qui tam litigation on behalf of the government over its government contracts, which could include claims for treble damages [3].

provenance.quote: Any failure by us to comply with the specific provisions in our customer contracts or any violation of government contracting regulations could result in the imposition of civil and criminal penalties, which may include termination of contracts, forfeiture of profits, suspension of payments and, in the case of our government contracts, fines and suspension from future government contracting.
